gloss: namer; person who gives a name; name-giver

definitions.gloss: namer; name-giver; the person who bestows a name on something or someone
definitions.explanation: The individual credited with choosing and giving the name of a person, place, product, species, building, or other entity. Most common in news articles and official contexts (e.g., ship launches, new species descriptions, naming-rights contracts) rather than everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だった。
examples.english: The person who named this star was a student.

examples.japanese: {新種|しんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: He will be recorded as the namer of the new species.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{商品名|しょうひんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{一年目|いちねんめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{若手社員|わかてしゃいん}だった⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: The person who came up with this product name was reportedly a young employee who had only just joined the company.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧ ('naming; to name') and the suffix {〜者|しゃ} ('person who does'). Literally 'naming person'.

USAGE:
- Most common in formal and written contexts: news articles, scientific descriptions of new species, accounts of corporate naming contests, and ship / facility launch ceremonies.
- In everyday conversation, people more often describe the action directly (e.g., ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, 'the person who gave it a name').
- Frequently paired with a specifier of what was named: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ} ('the namer of this product').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新種|しんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ}: namer of a new species
- {命名者|めいめいしゃ}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: namer unknown
- {命名者|めいめいしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known as the namer
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命名者|めいめいしゃ}: the person who named the product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名付|なづ}け⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: the one who gave (someone or something) its name — more emotional / literary; originally refers to the person who named a child, now extended figuratively to products and characters.
- ⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧: the act of naming — the action itself rather than the person.
- {発案者|はつあんしゃ}: the person who came up with the idea — broader; includes but is not limited to naming.
